主要内容: On March 30, 2017, Blonder Tongue Laboratories Inc, along with its subsidiaries, entered into a First Amendment to Loan and Security Agreement with Sterling National Bank. The amendment revised the fixed charge coverage ratio, deferred the first measurement period of financial covenants until January 31, 2017, and modified permitted investments. The amendment's effectiveness depends on conditions, including acknowledgment by subordinated lenders and a $15,000 fee to Sterling. The amendment also modifies the Loan Agreement with R. L. Drake Holdings, LLC as a Borrower, Blonder Tongue Far East, LLC as a Guarantor and Credit Party, and Sterling National Bank as Administrative Agent and Lender. The amendment allows Sterling to pursue its rights under the Loan Agreement in case of default, including non-payment of principal or interest.
